output:

HAPPY HAPPY NEWS!!! 🎉🎉🎉

Lorna Villaruz, your PIN number came through today and I am so happy I can't even type properly!!! @Lorna Villaruz

Do you remember Iloilo, our capping ceremony in 1996? Two girls with the same hairstyle and the same dream. We polished our white shoes every night, and you always borrowed my polish and never bought your own, haha. Some things never change!

Then you worked in Riyadh and Dubai for almost 18 years, and now you are a registered nurse in the UK and you are coming to Liverpool!!! After 20 years of me telling you to come, you finally said yes. When I left for the UK in 2004 you cried at the airport and said susunod ako, I will follow you. 22 years later, you are keeping your promise!

Here is the plan, so everybody knows:

Lorna lands at Manchester on 14 January, around 1pm, from Dubai.

She stays with us for the first month in the spare room. Ben has already said ok.

She starts on Ward 7 on 25 January, after her induction.

Lorna, I already sent you a photo of the rain so you know what you're getting into 😂 Please bring a proper coat, because the Liverpool wind is no joke. Not the cheap one from Divisoria! Ben and I will take you to Primark or TK Maxx so you can get a proper one.

Ward 7 is so lucky to have you. You are the calmest nurse I know, and the patients love you. I'm a midwife, so I know how important it is to have someone like that on the ward!

And to our Filipino family here in Merseyside, please welcome Lorna! You know the Christmas parties at St Teresa's, the potluck with too many pancit, and the raffle tickets. Lorna, you will be with us for Simbang Gabi next year, nine nights of it. Bring your appetite!

Welcome home, Lorna. Maligayang pagdating sa Liverpool! Bring the dried mangoes and the pili, and bring that big smile too. We have waited 20 years for this, and I am so proud of you!!! ❤️
